faq.title: What is CortexAnime?
faq.text: CortexAnime is a free, ad-free anime streaming platform where anime fans can find their favorite series. It aggregates content from various sources and makes it available in one place.

faq.title: Is it completely free?
faq.text: Yes! CortexAnime is completely free and ad-free. No subscription or registration is required to browse content. Registration unlocks extra features like watchlists and progress tracking.

faq.title: What anime is available?
faq.text: CortexAnime uses the AniList database, which contains tens of thousands of anime series and films. Content is loaded from various streaming sources, and the library is constantly growing.

faq.title: Is Hungarian subtitles available?
faq.text: Yes! Many anime series are available with Hungarian subtitles. In the search page, toggle the HU flag button to browse Hungarian-subtitled anime.

faq.title: Why isn't the player loading?
faq.text: The Cortex Player loads the global stream from the HiAnime library (via MegaPlay). If it doesn't load within 15 seconds, hit Retry - the VidNest backup source kicks in automatically when an episode is missing. Check your internet connection if issues persist.

faq.title: How do I switch servers?
faq.text: Switching is automatic: if an episode is missing from the HiAnime library, the player falls back to the VidNest source on its own - no manual server picking needed.

faq.title: What are the 8 server options?
faq.text: CortexAnime uses two stream sources: the HiAnime library (via MegaPlay - primary) and VidNest (backup with multiple internal servers such as AnimePahe). Availability varies by anime.

faq.title: How do avatar decorations work?
faq.text: After registering, go to Profile > Avatar Decorations. You can choose from Common, Rare, Epic, and Legendary Discord-style frame decorations. Decorations are sourced from avatardecoration.com.

faq.title: Can I sign in with Google?
faq.text: Yes! On the Profile page, tap 'Continue with Google' to sign in or register with your Google account. This requires a Google account and will create a CortexAnime profile linked to your email.

faq.title: Where is my data stored?
faq.text: Registration data (username, email, encrypted password) is stored securely on Cloudflare's infrastructure via D1 database. We never share personal data with third parties.

faq.title: Does it work on iPhone?
faq.text: Yes! CortexAnime is fully optimized for iPhone and Android. The interface uses iOS-style glass design. You can add it to your home screen for an app-like experience.

privacy.text: CortexAnime respects your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect and how we use it.
When you register, we store your username, email, and a password hash. Your watchlist and viewing progress are linked to your account.
If you log in with AniList, we store your AniList user ID to connect your account. We do not receive or store your AniList password.
We use a session cookie to keep you logged in. You can clear it by signing out.
We do not sell your data, show targeted ads, or track you across third-party sites.
Questions about privacy? Contact us at cortexanime@proton.me

dmca.text: Disclaimer
CortexAnime does not store any video content on its own servers. The site only links to third-party streaming sources and bears no responsibility for their content.
DMCA Takedown Procedure
If you believe content on this site infringes your copyright, submit a DMCA notice containing:
The exact URL of the infringing content
Identification of the copyrighted work
Your contact information
A good-faith statement that use is unauthorized
Your digital or physical signature
Contact
Send DMCA notices and copyright complaints to:
We typically respond within 3–5 business days.
Third-Party Sources
CortexAnime uses the following external data sources:
AniList
MyAnimeList / Jikan
TMDB
Hungarian fan communities
Various streaming sites
The respective streaming sites are responsible for infringing content. DMCA requests should be directed to the content source.
CortexAnime collects and stores the following:
Username and email (with encrypted password) on registration
Watchlist and progress (for registered users only)
No personal data is sold to third parties
Cloudflare's Privacy Policy
Not affiliated with AniList, MyAnimeList, or any anime studio.
